papers.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
papers.desc: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets.

papers.title: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
papers.desc: World and action modeling are closely related, yet their reciprocal benefits under unified causal training remain unclear.

papers.title: SUPRA-TEX: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Texture
papers.desc: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image.

papers.title: Virtual Head Attention
papers.desc: The design of attention mechanisms in long-context large language models faces an ``impossible triangle'' among KV cache size, training and prefill FLOPs, and model quality.

papers.title: FlashMask-3: Efficient and Expressive Mask-Aware Distributed Attention
papers.desc: Long-context training of large language and multimodal models couples structured attention masks (document, prefix-LM, share-question, sliding-window, block-sparse) with multi-node context parallelism, making the mask a dominant bottleneck.

papers.title: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
papers.desc: When does a language model acquire a capability? Developmental studies usually answer this by tracking when models start producing the correct token.

papers.title: Copy-Paste Language Models
papers.desc: Transformers are intuitively considered to be efficient at copying from their inputs.

papers.title: Explaining the Roles of Experts in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Personalization
papers.desc: Personalization of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly important for user-centric applications, yet prior methods mainly adapt dense LLMs, whose polysemantic neurons, each encoding multiple unrelated concepts, hinder localizing the components behind personalization, and thus understanding and controlling it.

papers.title: PAIR: Bridging Perception and Action in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.desc: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions.

papers.title: Beyond Policy Rollouts: Embedding-Space Directional Exploration with Anchored Noise for LLM RLVR
papers.desc: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically uses small rollout groups per prompt, where repeated sampling from the same policy can yield highly similar trajectories, reducing within-group reward variation and weakening group-relative advantage signals.

papers.title: One Bias Score, Two Factors: How Mitigations Affect Option Bias in Multiple-Choice Evaluation
papers.desc: Reordering multiple-choice options can change a model's answer, an effect studied as selection bias (a preference for certain option letters) and as order sensitivity (changes in answers across option orderings).

papers.title: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
papers.desc: We introduce Gen4P, a unified framework for recovering 4D geometry and motion from monocular video.

papers.title: Speech event detector: Timestamped detection of non-verbal vocalizations and background sounds for rich speech transcription
papers.desc: Automatic speech recognition produces words but drops the non-verbal content of a recording: the breaths, coughs, sighs and laughter of the speaker, and the horns, music or barking around them.

papers.title: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.desc: Autoregressive video diffusion models have become a leading approach to real-time interactive video generation and video world modeling.

papers.title: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill
papers.desc: Reusing the attention KV cache across requests is a standard way to cut prefill cost in long-context LLM serving, and production systems increasingly back the per-engine cache with a remote tier shared by every engine.
